description:
## Goal

Make the real `ReturnType` and `ActivationInputs` consumers retain exactly the semantic alternatives that still have independent support, so cyclic copies are never mistaken for new ground.

This replaces today's grow-only ActivationInputs exception with a finite, consumer-owned model that preserves convergence and supports exact withdrawal. It is not a generic scheduler provenance layer.

## Model gate

Before production changes, work the smallest real examples on paper and specify the finite representation, join/transfer laws, strict-movement bound, and corpus cost. Each retained semantic alternative must preserve its exact owner-qualified source/semantic-edge and operand requirements before aggregate joins erase them. Alternative justifications are OR; jointly required evidence is AND. Source origin alone is insufficient when a forwarding/transform edge disappears.

The existing World typed stores remain the only value authorities. Support is part of the consumer's contribution value, not a second store or scheduler identity. Reads remain invalidation dependencies; finality remains a separate quiescence law. Do not add a flow/proof graph, generic support map, SCC/cone solver, reconstruction/repair pass, retained World image, per-derivation publisher, or display/raw-ID authority.

If no finite affordable consumer representation passes this gate, update this description and stop; do not land scaffolding.

## Required laws

- `A = seed union B; B = A`: removing the last external justification retracts both to bottom; independent `y` survives removal of `x`.
- One publisher may produce grounded `x` and cyclic-only `y`: retain only `x`.
- Removing one of two equal grounded publishers preserves aggregate allocation/revision; removing the second retracts.
- Removing a forwarding edge retracts its downstream alternative even while the origin remains.
- Temporary absence of callee return evidence does not erase structurally reachable independent continuation callsites or invent a value. This absorbs `fz-kdt.76`.
- Contract refinement is per correlated row/alternative. Empty intersection is an explicit row diagnostic, never “keep the first observed result”; source/input order cannot select `ReturnType`. This absorbs `fz-kdt.190`.
- Retract/reappear clears stale typed slots and mints revision zero only from actual bottom.
- Failed and Blocked attempt owners use `fz-tfn.46` outcomes without preserving unsupported prior content.
- Equal supported reproduction retains allocation/generation and wakes nobody.

Prove the `fz-kdt.106` 8/9-row budget-cliff cycle terminates under FIFO, LIFO, and permuted admission before enabling any narrowing. Today's grow-only behavior is a current convergence constraint, not a permanent semantic contract.

## Interaction with later tickets

Transfer only the paired-row correctness necessary for this consumer from `fz-kdt.48`; broader one-Ty-per-denotation work remains there. `fz-kdt.200` still owns final InputDemand derivation and private cone deletion, but no key-derived evidence or resurrection path may remain that can invalidate this ticket's guarantees. `fz-tfn.14` later owns proportional maintenance of the final ActivationInputs store, not its semantic support law.

## Required deletion and signal

Delete `conclude_preserving_frontier`, old ActivationInputs frontier preservation, absent-Activation standing-claim replay, stale typed-slot reuse, first-row return selection, and obsolete docs/tests only when the final consumer model replaces them. Preserve all semantic answers/artifacts and reduce or exactly explain evaluations, wakes, allocations, and store work. Full focused, causal, determinism, library, matrix, CLI, formatting, check, and strict-Clippy gates pass. Fresh ticket-scoped cold adversarial review precedes one commit and close.

comments.text: RIDER (fz-kdt.106 landed, a010532e8, 2026-09-01): NOT dissolved, but the decision is easier now. Dominance absorption removed the ascent-history accumulation that made input narrowing look necessary (the predicate wide cone is gone; per-callsite maxima are what settle). The asymmetry itself stands: ActivationInputs still cannot narrow on rebase while ReturnType can, and fz-kdt.82's withdrawal-as-ascent hazard still gates enabling it. Also relevant: both replace-shaped semantics were REFUTED BY PROTOTYPE during 106 (non-settlement via the budget-cliff ping-pong through the caller-callee 2-cycle; see fz-kdt.106's record) -- any resolution of this ticket that adds a mid-drive narrowing path must answer that refutation.

title: Retain only supported ReturnType and ActivationInputs alternatives
